raw_segments.text: Friar, Lawrence, Peace, Ho, For Shame, Confusions, Cure Lives, Not in These Confusions,
Heaven and Yourself Had Part in This Fair Maid, Now Heaven Hath All, And All the Better Is It for the Maid,
Your Part in Her You Could Not Keep from Death, But Heaven Keeps His Part in Eternal Life,
The Most You Sought Was Her Promotion, For Twas Your Heaven She Should Be Advanked,
And Weepy Now, Seeing She Is Above the Clouds, As High as Heaven Itself,
O, In This Love, You Love Your Child So Ill That You Run Mad, Seeing That She Is Well,
She's Not Well Married That Lives Married Long, But She's Best Married That Dies Married Young,
Dry Up Your Tears And Stick Your Rosemary on This Fair Course, And As The Custom Is,
And In Her Best Array Bear Her to Church, For Though Fond Nature Bids Us All Lament,
Yet Nature's Tears Are Reason's Merriment.
Friar Lawrence, peace hoe for shame. Confusions cure lives not in these confusions. Heaven
and yourself had part in this fair maid, now heaven hath all, and all the better is it
for the maid. Your part in her you could not keep from death, but heaven keeps his part
in eternal life. The most you sought was her promotion, for toise your heaven she should
be advanced, and weepy now, seeing she is above the clouds, as high as heaven itself.
Oh, in this love, you love your child so ill that you run mad, seeing that she is well.
She's not well married that lives married long, but she's best married that dies married
young. Dry up your tears and stick your rosemary on this fair course, and as the custom is,
and in her best array bear her to church, for though fond nature bids us all lament,
yet nature's tears are reason's merriment.
